limitations_mentioned: The analysis assumes linearity; subtle nonlinearities may go undetected given the sample size.
In choosing between highly correlated features, there is some arbitrariness; alternative selection might yield similar results.
Findings are strictly limited to this dataset; external validity is not established.
Bonferroni is conservative; weaker effects (e.g., X2) may be real but not pass this stringent threshold.
